title: uwf-uwow-world
label: Randy Orton

won.source: the fed's own served title-history ledger

how: Won a Triple Threat Match against John Bradshaw Layfield and Ric Flair — the three remaining contenders from the aborted tournament.
note: The fed's own title-history ledger (footnote *5) credits this reign to a Triple Threat at 'UWF Brand New Fear, Jan 09' -- a show this wing's own held corpus never captured (event points at the interfed placeholder 'uwow-brand-new-fear-2009', not a served uwf-uwow page). The 16-man tournament that produced these three finalists (Orton, JBL, Flair) is shown in this wing's own served Starrcade script (Dec '08) running through the semifinals, but that broadcast itself cuts to a riot and a police shutdown -- following Vince McMahon's arrival and the Stephanie McMahon kidnapping angle -- before the scheduled final is fought on the page. An honest gap, not a contradiction: the tournament's start is corroborated by served text, its finish is ledger-sourced only, at an event outside this wing's own held corpus.
